description:
Candidates must have: 
 • PHP Application Development experience. This is important, because many PHP developers consider themselves Web Developers. But the client is using PHP frameworks for application development. 
• Strong experience with PHP frameworks like MVC or Zend or related frameworks. 
• Solid understanding of Linux. 
• Strong scripting skills. 
• Experienced in an Agile environment with 2 week sprints.


 Basic 

• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 Additional Information 

** U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor at this time.

 Note:- 

1.Only US Citizen, Green Card Holder and GC-EAD can apply.
2.No OPT-EAD & H1B Consultants please.
3.Please mention your Visa Status in your email or resume.
